title: CNBC: Dollar eases as markets await Fed decision
summary: CNBC: Dollar eases as markets await Fed decision
body_markdown:
‘"Traders are taking steps to preserve liquidity and adding to dollar longs ahead of tomorrow's decision," ‌said[Karl Schamotta](https://app.hubspot.com/social/43897234/manage/published?page=19&post=linkedincompanypage%3A76182920%3A7487994473772105728#) , chief market strategist at[Corpay Cross-Border Solutions](https://www.linkedin.com/company/76182920) in Toronto. "On the face of it, the setup seems bullish for the dollar either way: an outright hike would deliver an unequivocal boost, while a hawkish hold would ​simply push expectations into September," Schamotta said. He warned, however, that speculative positioning in favor of the dollar was stretched and that any hint of a more dovish approach from policymakers could trigger a violent unwind.’
